reading: Ed Sheeran addressed the recent upheaval caused by rapper Macklemore's removal from his concert tour, speaking about free speech and the Israel-Gaza situation.
He stated he had never intended to be an activist musician, but the situation placed him amid a passionate debate on free speech and the world's most complex political issue.
During his Philadelphia show, Sheeran described the 7 October 2023 attacks as "horrific" and labeled the events unfolding in Gaza as "unjustifiable."
The widespread unease led to several artists withdrawing from the tour, with ticket sales declining and prices dropping for the remaining US leg.
Sheeran clarified that the decision to drop Macklemore originated from his promoters, not from him personally.
He expressed his belief that his concerts should always be a safe space for everyone, underscoring his commitment to his fans.
Emphasizing a humanitarian perspective, Sheeran articulated his distress over the "catastrophic and unjustifiable and disproportionate" events in Gaza.
He conveyed profound sorrow for the immense devastation, the loss of civilian lives, and the systemic injustice witnessed in the West Bank.
Sheeran also voiced strong objections to the concept of venues "preapproving" performers or their content, a stance met with audience applause.
Outside the venue, a few dozen protestors waved flags as ticket holders streamed in, yet the concert proceeded largely unfettered.
Attendees interviewed by the BBC shared a common resolve to enjoy the music while simultaneously championing freedom of speech.
Macklemore's original performance involved a song dedicated to pro-Palestinian protestors, in which he referred to "genocide" in Gaza, a term Israel disputes.
Messina Touring Group indicated that Macklemore's departure was due to certain venues threatening to cancel concerts if he performed.
Robert Kraft, owner of Gillette Stadium, subsequently confirmed his decision to bar Macklemore from performing at Sheeran's upcoming shows there.

vocabulary.definition: A violent or sudden change or disruption to something.
In the middle of or surrounded by.
Expressed or stated clearly and coherently.
Too large or too small in comparison to something else; lacking appropriate balance or relation.
Very great or intense; having or showing great knowledge or insight.
Relating to a system, especially as opposed to a particular part; affecting a whole body or system.
Expressions or feelings of disapproval or opposition; reasons for disagreeing.
Not bound by chains or shackles; unrestrained or unrestricted, allowing complete freedom.
Supporting the cause of; defending or advocating for.

entries.ja: 何かに対する暴力的または突然の変化や混乱。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 대한 폭력적이거나 갑작스러운 변화 또는 혼란.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某事物的剧烈或突然的改变或扰乱。
entries.es: Un cambio o una perturbación violenta o repentina en algo.
entries.pt-BR: Uma mudança ou perturbação violenta ou repentina em algo.

entries.ja: ～の真ん中に、または～に囲まれて。
entries.es: En medio de o rodeado por.
entries.pt-BR: No meio de ou cercado por.

entries.ja: 明確かつ首尾一貫して表現された、または述べられた。
entries.zh-Hans: 清楚而连贯地表达或陈述。
entries.es: Expresado o declarado de manera clara y coherente.
entries.pt-BR: Expressou ou declarou de forma clara e coerente.

entries.ja: 他の何かと比較して大きすぎる、または小さすぎる。適切な均衡や関連性を欠いている。
entries.ko: 다른 어떤 것과 비교하여 너무 크거나 너무 작은; 적절한 균형이나 관계가 부족한.
entries.zh-Hans: 与其他事物相比太大或太小；缺乏适当的平衡或关联。
entries.es: Demasiado grande o demasiado pequeño en comparación con otra cosa; que carece de equilibrio o relación adecuados.
entries.pt-BR: Grande ou pequeno demais em comparação com outra coisa; que não possui equilíbrio ou relação apropriados.

entries.ja: 伝えられた、または知らされた。伝達された。
entries.es: Comunicado o dado a conocer; transmitido.

entries.ja: 非常に大きい、または強烈な。深い知識や洞察力を持っている、または示している。
entries.ko: 매우 크거나 강렬한; 깊은 지식이나 통찰력을 가지고 있거나 보여주는.
entries.zh-Hans: 非常大或强烈；拥有或显示出渊博的知识或深刻的洞察力。
entries.es: Muy grande o intenso; que tiene o muestra gran conocimiento o perspicacia.
entries.pt-BR: Muito grande ou intenso; que tem ou demonstra grande conhecimento ou perspicácia.

entries.ja: 特に特定の部分とは対照的に、システムに関連する。全体またはシステムに影響を及ぼす。
entries.ko: 특히 특정 부분과 반대로 시스템과 관련된; 전체 몸이나 시스템에 영향을 미치는.
entries.zh-Hans: 与某个系统相关的，尤其是与特定部分相对而言；影响整个身体或系统。
entries.es: Relacionado con un sistema, especialmente en contraposición a una parte particular; que afecta a un cuerpo o sistema completo.
entries.pt-BR: Relacionado a um sistema, especialmente em oposição a uma parte específica; que afeta um corpo ou sistema inteiro.

entries.ja: 不承認や反対の表明または感情。意見が一致しない理由。
entries.ko: 반대나 불승인의 표현이나 감정; 동의하지 않는 이유.
entries.zh-Hans: 表示或感觉不满或反对；不同意的理由。
entries.es: Expresiones o sentimientos de desaprobación u oposición; razones para no estar de acuerdo.
entries.pt-BR: Expressões ou sentimentos de desaprovação ou oposição; razões para discordar.

entries.ja: 鎖や手かせに縛られていない。抑制されず、制限がなく、完全な自由を許している。
entries.ko: 사슬이나 족쇄에 묶이지 않은; 억제되지 않거나 제한되지 않아 완전한 자유를 허용하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 不受锁链或桎梏束缚；不受限制或约束，允许完全的自由。
entries.es: No atado por cadenas o grilletes; sin restricciones o limitaciones, permitiendo total libertad.
entries.pt-BR: Não preso por correntes ou grilhões; irrestrito ou sem restrições, permitindo total liberdade.

entries.ja: ～の大義を支持すること。～を擁護すること、または支持すること。
entries.ko: 어떤 대의를 지지하는 것; 옹호하거나 변호하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 支持某项事业；为其辩护或倡导。
entries.es: Apoyar la causa de; defender o abogar por.
entries.pt-BR: Apoiar a causa de; defender ou advogar por.
